title: WikiPulse late event v1
description: Record of an event that arrived after its event-time window had closed (window end + grace). Written to topic wikipulse.page_change.late.v1. The event itself is still in the bronze layer and is counted by the batch recompute.

observed_at.description: Processing time at which the late arrival was detected.

lateness_seconds.description: Seconds between window close (end + grace) and the watermark at detection.
